<!--
Custom-code child fragment inserted into regionReport::DESeq2Report()'s
auto-generated report via the `customCode` argument.

Placeholders are substituted at runtime by ExpressOM:

{{PCA_FILE}}       - PCA plot
{{PCA_CORR_FILE}}  - PCA plot after batch correction, optional
{{HEATMAP_FILE}}   - Sample correlation heatmap
{{VOLCANO_FILE}}   - Volcano plot
{{MA_FILE}}        - MA plot, shrunken

This version:
- does nothing for empty optional paths,
- warns cleanly for missing non-empty paths,
- embeds PNG/JPG/SVG images directly,
- provides a download link for PDFs, because browsers usually cannot render
  PDF files through an HTML <img> tag.
-->

```{r expressom_custom_setup, include=FALSE}
.expressom_fig <- function(path, caption = "") {
  if (is.null(path) || length(path) == 0 || !nzchar(path)) {
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n*Figure not found: `%s`*\n\n", path))
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(path))

  if (ext %in% c("png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "svg")) {
    cat(sprintf("\n![%s](%s)\n\n", caption, path))
  } else {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "\n[Download PDF: %s](%s)\n\n",
        if (nzchar(caption)) caption else basename(path),
        path
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r expressom_custom_figures, results='asis'}
.expressom_fig("{{PCA_FILE}}", "PCA plot")

.expressom_fig("{{PCA_CORR_FILE}}", "PCA plot after batch correction")

.expressom_fig("{{HEATMAP_FILE}}", "Sample correlation heatmap")

.expressom_fig("{{VOLCANO_FILE}}", "Volcano plot")

.expressom_fig("{{MA_FILE}}", "MA plot (shrunken)")
```
